document_type.description: Classify the entire PDF. Use invoice only for a document requesting payment for goods or services. A multi-page invoice is one invoice. Statements, receipts, credit notes and ambiguous documents must not be classified as invoices.

document_type_reason.description: Brief explanation of why the document received this classification.

vendor_name.description: Supplier name as shown on the invoice

due_date.description: Invoice payment due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use null if not specified.

invoice_total.description: Total invoice amount including applicable taxes

currency.description: Three-letter currency code such as AUD or USD

line_items.description: Every invoice line item in its original order

extraction_issues.description: Missing, unclear or conflicting invoice information
